source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Limit collaboration to administrative tasks because clinical care should remain professionally isolated","B":"Replace profession-specific education so every health profession develops the same scope of practice","C":"Keep professions separated during training to prevent overlap in communication or team responsibilities","D":"Prepare learners to communicate and collaborate effectively across professions in team-based care"}}
source_row.rationale: IPEC's current Core Competencies are designed to prepare learners for interprofessional collaborative practice, including communication, roles and responsibilities, teamwork, and shared values in person-centered care.
source_row.source_detail: Version 3, November 2023; competency framework for interprofessional education and collaborative practice; accessed 2026-08-14.

source_row.stem: What is a primary purpose of interprofessional education in health professions training?
